Fields.Name: Destination Weather: Sunny
Fields.Description: Weather type used in the cutscene when the in-game weather is Sunny (type 0). Weather types: 0 Sunny, 1 Clear Sky, 10 Light Cloud, 11 Cloud, 20 Rain, 21 Heavy Rain, 30 Storm, 31 Storm for Battle, 40 Snow, 41 Heavy Snow, 50 Fog, 51 Heavy Fog, 52 Heavy Fog and Rain, 60 Sandstorm, 81 Snowstorm, 82 Lightning Storm, 83–88 reserved. The type selects the WeatherParam row (see Use Area Weather Variant).

Fields.Name: Indoor/Outdoor Type
Fields.Description: 1 (Indoor): the cutscene uses the weather's indoor SFX and no outdoor or wind SFX. 0 (Outdoor): the weather's outdoor and wind SFX. The weather's general SFX plays either way.

Fields.Name: Keep Weather SFX: Sunny
Fields.Description: When the cutscene's weather is Sunny: on keeps that weather's SFX (general, indoor/outdoor and wind) during the cutscene; off plays none of them. The weather's sound plays either way.

Fields.Name: Use Area Weather Variant
Fields.Description: On: the cutscene uses the area's variant of its weather, WeatherParam row area ID × 100 + weather type, as in-game play does (the plain weather-type row if that row doesn't exist). Off: always the plain weather-type row.

Fields.Name: Override Weather Area ID
Fields.Description: Area ID used for Use Area Weather Variant instead of the current area's. -1: the current area's. Ignored when Use Area Weather Variant is off.
